303: def parse_tender_positions_from_text(text: str) -> list[TenderPosition]:
304:     """Extract tender positions from CSV or table/block text on the tender portal."""
305:     positions: dict[str, TenderPosition] = {}
306:     cleaned = strip_zwc(text)
307: 
308:     # 1. CSV lines: Position;Kurztext;Menge;Einheit;Anforderung -> 01.01;...;24;Stk;A-1
309:     for line in cleaned.splitlines():
310:         parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(";")]
311:         if len(parts) >= 5 and re.match(r"^\d{2}\.\d{2}$", parts[0]):
312:             pos_id, desc, qty_s, unit, req_ref = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2], parts[3], parts[4]
313:             try:
314:                 positions[pos_id] = TenderPosition(
315:                     position=pos_id,
316:                     requirement_ref=req_ref,
317:                     original_quantity=int(parse_locale_decimal(qty_s)),
318:                     unit=unit,
319:                     description=desc,
320:                 )
321:             except ValueError:
322:                 pass
323: 
324:     # 2. Tabular or block lines: Position: 01.01 ... Menge: 24 Stk ... Anforderungsreferenz: A-1
325:     block_matches = re.finditer(
326:         r"Position:\s*(\d{2}\.\d{2}).*?Menge:\s*(\d+)\s*([A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß]+).*?Anforderungsreferenz:\s*(A-\d+)",
327:         cleaned,
328:         re.DOTALL,
329:     )
330:     for m in block_matches:
331:         pos_id, qty_s, unit, req_ref = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3), m.group(4)
332:         if pos_id not in positions:
333:             positions[pos_id] = TenderPosition(
334:                 position=pos_id,
335:                 requirement_ref=req_ref.strip(),
336:                 original_quantity=int(qty_s),
337:                 unit=unit.strip(),
338:             )
339: 
340:     # 3. Table rows: 01.01 \t ... \t 24 \t Stk \t A-1
341:     for line in cleaned.splitlines():
342:         m_row = re.search(
343:             r"\b(\d{2}\.\d{2})\b\s+([^\t\n]+?)\s+(\d+)\s+(Stk|Stück|Satz|ST)\s+(A-\d+)\b",
344:             line,
345:             re.IGNORECASE,
346:         )
347:         if m_row:
348:             pos_id, desc, qty_s, unit, req_ref = m_row.groups()
349:             if pos_id not in positions:
350:                 positions[pos_id] = TenderPosition(
351:                     position=pos_id,
352:                     requirement_ref=req_ref.strip(),
353:                     original_quantity=int(qty_s),
354:                     unit=unit.strip(),
355:                     description=desc.strip(),
356:                 )
357: 
358:     return sorted(positions.values(), key=lambda x: x.position)

361: def parse_qa_pages(qa_texts: list[str]) -> list[QAClarification]:
362:     """Parse paginated Q&A answers from the tender portal."""
363:     clarifications: list[QAClarification] = []
364:     seen_numbers: set[str] = set()
365: 
366:     for page_text in qa_texts:
367:         cleaned = strip_zwc(page_text)
368:         # Split by Q&A entry headers: "<number> \t Eingang ... \t"
369:         entries = re.split(r"(?m)^(?=\d{3,6}\s+Eingang)", cleaned)
370:         for entry in entries:
371:             m_head = re.match(
372:                 r"^(\d{3,6})\s+Eingang\s*([^\t\n]*)\s*(.*)",
373:                 entry.strip(),
374:                 re.DOTALL,
375:             )
376:             if not m_head:
377:                 continue
378:             q_num, date_part, body = m_head.groups()
379:             if q_num in seen_numbers:
380:                 continue
381:             seen_numbers.add(q_num)
382: 
383:             ts = parse_timestamp(date_part) or parse_timestamp(body) or datetime(2027, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
384:             qa = QAClarification(number=q_num, timestamp=ts, text=body.strip())
385: 
386:             # 1. Check withdrawal: "Antwort auf Rückfrage 8152 wird ... zurückgezogen"
387:             m_with = re.search(
388:                 r"(?:Rückfrage|Antwort|Frage)\s+(\d{3,6})\b[^\n.]*?(?:zurückgezogen|widerrufen|storniert|ungültig)",
389:                 body,
390:                 re.IGNORECASE,
391:             )
392:             if not m_with:
393:                 m_with = re.search(
394:                     r"(?:zurückgezogen|widerrufen).*?(?:Rückfrage|Antwort|Frage)\s+(\d{3,6})\b",
395:                     body,
396:                     re.IGNORECASE,
397:                 )
398:             if m_with:
399:                 qa.withdrawn_number = m_with.group(1)
400: 
401:             # 2. Check quantity change (only if not a withdrawal notice)
402:             if not qa.withdrawn_number:
403:                 # Look for canvas or prose quantity changes
404:                 m_qty_canvas = re.search(
405:                     r"\[CANVAS:\s*Verbindliche Gesamtmenge:\s*Position\s*(\d{2}\.\d{2}):\s*(\d+)",
406:                     body,
407:                     re.IGNORECASE,
408:                 )
409:                 m_qty_prose = re.search(
410:                     r"Position\s*(\d{2}\.\d{2})\b[^\n.]*?(?:beträgt|nun|neu|Gesamtmenge|Menge)[^\d\n]*(\d+)\s*(Stück|Stk|Satz|ST)?",
411:                     body,
412:                     re.IGNORECASE,
413:                 )
414:                 if m_qty_canvas:
415:                     pos_id = m_qty_canvas.group(1)
416:                     qty_val = int(m_qty_canvas.group(2))
417:                     unit_val = m_qty_prose.group(3) if (m_qty_prose and m_qty_prose.group(3)) else ""
418:                     qa.quantity_changes.append((pos_id, qty_val, unit_val))
419:                 elif m_qty_prose and ("menge" in body.lower() or "abrufmenge" in body.lower()):
420:                     pos_id = m_qty_prose.group(1)
421:                     qty_val = int(m_qty_prose.group(2))
422:                     unit_val = m_qty_prose.group(3) or ""
423:                     qa.quantity_changes.append((pos_id, qty_val, unit_val))
424: 
425:             # 3. Check scoped technical amendments: "Revision R-6156, Anforderung A-2: Hub/Stellweg = 482 mm"
426:             for m_amend in re.finditer(
427:                 r"Revision\s+(R-\d+)\s*,\s*Anforderung\s+(A-\d+)\s*:\s*([^=:\n]+?)\s*[=:]\s*(\d+|\S+)",
428:                 body,
429:                 re.IGNORECASE,
430:             ):
431:                 rev, req_ref, attr_name, attr_val = m_amend.groups()
432:                 qa.tech_amendments.append((rev.strip(), req_ref.strip(), attr_name.strip(), attr_val.strip()))
433: 
434:             # 4. Check position assignments (Konditionsgruppe, Verpackungstarif, Terminschlüssel, Rüstpool, Bonusplan)
435:             pos_matches = re.findall(r"Position\s+(\d{2}\.\d{2})", body)
436:             target_pos = pos_matches[0] if pos_matches else None
437:             if target_pos:
438:                 m_kg = re.search(r"Konditionsgruppe\s+(K-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
439:                 if m_kg:
440:                     qa.condition_groups[target_pos] = m_kg.group(1)
441: 
442:                 m_vp = re.search(r"Verpackungstarif\s+(VP-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
443:                 if m_vp:
444:                     qa.packaging_tariffs[target_pos] = m_vp.group(1)
445: 
446:                 m_tz = re.search(r"Terminschlüssel\s+(TZ-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
447:                 if m_tz:
448:                     qa.delivery_commitments[target_pos] = m_tz.group(1)
449: 
450:                 m_rp = re.search(r"Rüstpool\s+(RP-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
451:                 if m_rp:
452:                     qa.setup_pools[target_pos] = m_rp.group(1)
453: 
454:                 m_pb = re.search(r"Bonusplan\s+(PB-\d+)", body, re.IGNORECASE)
455:                 if m_pb:
456:                     qa.bonus_plans[target_pos] = m_pb.group(1)
457: 
458:                 # Ordinary setup fee: "Für Position 01.03 sind einmalig 85,00 EUR netto Rüstkosten anzusetzen"
459:                 m_setup = re.search(
460:                     r"einmalig\s+([\d.,]+\s*(?:\((?:de-DE|en-US)\))?)\s*EUR\s*(?:netto\s*)?Rüstkosten",
461:                     body,
462:                     re.IGNORECASE,
463:                 )
464:                 if m_setup:
465:                     qa.ordinary_setup_fees[target_pos] = parse_locale_decimal(m_setup.group(1), "de-DE")
466: 
467:             clarifications.append(qa)
468: 
469:     return clarifications

472: def parse_spec_pages(spec_texts: list[str]) -> dict[str, RequirementSpec]:
473:     """Parse specification viewer pages into RequirementSpec objects."""
474:     reqs: dict[str, RequirementSpec] = {}
475:     for text in spec_texts:
476:         cleaned = strip_zwc(text)
477:         # Match requirement ID (A-1, A-2, etc.)
478:         m_req = re.search(r"\b(A-\d+)\b", cleaned)
479:         if not m_req:
480:             continue
481:         req_id = m_req.group(1)
482: 
483:         # Extract bore (from canvas or Originalwortlaut)
484:         bore = 0
485:         m_bore_canvas = re.search(r"Bohrung\s*\(mm\)\s*:\s*(\d+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
486:         m_bore_prose = re.search(r"Bohrung\s+(\d+)\s*mm", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
487:         if m_bore_canvas:
488:             bore = int(m_bore_canvas.group(1))
489:         elif m_bore_prose:
490:             bore = int(m_bore_prose.group(1))
491: 
492:         # Extract stroke
493:         stroke = 0
494:         m_stroke_prose = re.search(r"Hub\s+(\d+)\s*mm", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
495:         if m_stroke_prose:
496:             stroke = int(m_stroke_prose.group(1))
497:         else:
498:             m_stroke_col = re.search(r"\]\s*(\d+)\s*\((?:en-US|de-DE)\)", cleaned)
499:             if m_stroke_col:
500:                 stroke = int(m_stroke_col.group(1))
501: 
502:         # Extract pressure
503:         pressure = 0
504:         m_press_prose = re.search(r"(?:Betriebsdruck|Druck)\s+(\d+)\s*bar", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
505:         if m_press_prose:
506:             pressure = int(m_press_prose.group(1))
507: 
508:         # Extract mounting
509:         mounting = ""
510:         m_mount = re.search(r"Befestigung\s+([A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß\-]+?)(?:,|\.|;|\s+Zertifizierung)", cleaned)
511:         if m_mount:
512:             mounting = m_mount.group(1).strip()
513: 
514:         # Extract certification (prefer tooltip after Prüfvermerk, else prose)
515:         cert = "Keine"
516:         m_cert_tip = re.search(r"Prüfvermerk\s*(.+?)\s*siehe Freigabestand", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
517:         if m_cert_tip:
518:             c_raw = m_cert_tip.group(1).strip()
519:             cert = "Keine" if "keine" in c_raw.lower() else c_raw
520:         else:
521:             m_cert_prose = re.search(r"Zertifizierung\s+([^.,;\n]+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
522:             if m_cert_prose:
523:                 c_raw = m_cert_prose.group(1).strip()
524:                 cert = "Keine" if "keine" in c_raw.lower() else c_raw
525: 
526:         # Extract Kataloggruppe
527:         cat_group = ""
528:         m_cat = re.search(r"Kataloggruppe\s+(GR-\d+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
529:         if m_cat:
530:             cat_group = m_cat.group(1).strip()
531: 
532:         # Check nutzbarer Weg & Endreserve-Schlüssel
533:         is_usable = bool(re.search(r"nutzbarer\s+Weg", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE))
534:         end_res_key = None
535:         m_er = re.search(r"Endreserve-Schlüssel\s+(ER-\d+)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
536:         if m_er:
537:             end_res_key = m_er.group(1).strip()
538: 
539:         # Check Satz conversion: "1 Satz = 5 Stück"
540:         pps = 1
541:         m_set = re.search(r"1\s*Satz\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*(?:Stück|Stk|ST)", cleaned, re.IGNORECASE)
542:         if m_set:
543:             pps = int(m_set.group(1))
544: 
545:         reqs[req_id] = RequirementSpec(
546:             req_id=req_id,
547:             bore_mm=bore,
548:             stroke_mm=stroke,
549:             pressure_bar=pressure,
550:             mounting=mounting,
551:             certification=cert,
552:             catalogue_group=cat_group,
553:             is_usable_stroke=is_usable,
554:             end_reserve_key=end_res_key,
555:             pieces_per_set=pps,
556:         )
557:     return reqs

371: ) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
372:     """Run a search in `folder` for `query` and return `(msg_id, subject, iso_datetime)` tuples."""
373:     discovered: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
374:     seen_ids: set[str] = set()
375: 
376:     for pg in range(1, max_pages + 1):
377:         url = f"{base_url}/?folder={quote_plus(folder)}&q={quote_plus(query)}&page={pg}"
378:         await safe_goto(page, url)
379:         rows = await page.evaluate(
380:             """() => {
381:             const out = [];
382:             document.querySelectorAll('#messages tr').forEach(tr => {
383:                 const a = tr.querySelector('a[href*="message="]');
384:                 if (!a) return;
385:                 const href = a.getAttribute('href') || '';
386:                 const subj = (a.innerText || '').trim();
387:                 const timeEl = tr.querySelector('time[datetime]');
388:                 const dt = timeEl ? (timeEl.getAttribute('datetime') || '') : '';
389:                 out.push({ href, subj, dt });
390:             });
391:             return out;
392:         }"""
393:         )
394:         new_on_page = 0
395:         for r in rows:
396:             href = strip_zwc(r.get("href", ""))
397:             m_id = re.search(r"message=([^&]+)", href)
398:             if not m_id:
399:                 continue
400:             mid = m_id.group(1)
401:             if mid not in seen_ids:
402:                 seen_ids.add(mid)
403:                 discovered.append((mid, strip_zwc(r.get("subj", "")), strip_zwc(r.get("dt", ""))))
404:                 new_on_page += 1
405:         if new_on_page == 0:
406:             break

488: def pick_select_option(options: list[dict[str, str]], desired: str, is_cert: bool = False) -> str:
489:     """Pick the matching `<option value="...">` from a `<select>` element's options."""
490:     non_empty = [o for o in options if o.get("v", "") != ""]
491:     if is_cert and normalize_cert(desired) == "keine":
492:         for o in non_empty:
493:             v_str = o.get("v", "")
494:             t_str = o.get("t", "")
495:             if (
496:                 normalize_cert(v_str) == "keine"
497:                 or normalize_cert(t_str) == "keine"
498:                 or "ohne" in t_str.lower()
499:                 or "keine" in t_str.lower()
500:             ):
501:                 return v_str
502:     for o in non_empty:
503:         v_str = o.get("v", "")
504:         t_str = o.get("t", "")
505:         if (
506:             v_str.lower() == desired.lower()
507:             or desired.lower() in t_str.lower()
508:             or desired.lower() in v_str.lower()
509:         ):
510:             return v_str
511:     if len(non_empty) == 1:
512:         return non_empty[0]["v"]
513:     return desired

530: async def poll_for_new_tan(
531:     mail_page,
532:     mail_base_url: str,
533:     tender_reference: str,
534:     previous_msg_ids: set[str],
535: ) -> str:
536:     """Poll the webmail inbox for a newly arrived Signatur-TAN message and return the TAN code."""
537:     for attempt in range(10):
538:         await safe_goto(mail_page, f"{mail_base_url}/?folder=inbox&q=")
539:         hrefs = await mail_page.evaluate(
540:             """() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#messages a[href*="message="]')).map(a => a.getAttribute('href') || '')"""
541:         )
542:         msg_ids: list[str] = []
543:         for h in hrefs:
544:             m = re.search(r"message=([^&]+)", strip_zwc(h))
545:             if m:
546:                 mid = m.group(1)
547:                 if mid not in msg_ids:
548:                     msg_ids.append(mid)
549: 
550:         # Prefer any newly arrived message ID not in previous_msg_ids; fallback to first signing message
551:         target_ids = [mid for mid in msg_ids if mid not in previous_msg_ids]
552:         if not target_ids and attempt >= 3 and msg_ids:
553:             target_ids = [msg_ids[0]]
554: 
555:         for mid in target_ids:
556:             msg_text = await safe_goto(mail_page, f"{mail_base_url}/messages/{quote_plus(mid)}")
557:             body = msg_text.split("Original folgt", 1)[-1] if "Original folgt" in msg_text else msg_text
558:             m_tan = re.search(
559:                 rf"Signatur-TAN\s+für\s+{re.escape(tender_reference)}\s*:\s*([A-Z0-9]{{6,12}})",
560:                 body,
561:                 re.IGNORECASE,
562:             ) or re.search(r"Signatur-TAN[^:\n]*:\s*([A-Z0-9]{6,12})", body, re.IGNORECASE)
563:             if m_tan:
564:                 return m_tan.group(1).strip()
565: 
566:         await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
567: 
568:     raise RuntimeError(f"Could not find Signatur-TAN for {tender_reference} in webmail.")
